title: World's Greatest Train Ride Videos VHS Lot of 3 China India Scotland Wales NEW
condition_description: All 3 factory sealed. China has a handwritten price sticker on the wrap; all have small tears in the shrink wrap at the edges (pictured).
description:
Lot of 3 World's Greatest Train Ride Videos (Publishers Choice Video), all factory sealed:

- China (VHS NSI YG8) - Beijing, the Great Wall, the Imperial Palace and the Forbidden City
- India (VHS NSI YF5) - Delhi, the Taj Mahal, the Orient Express and the River Ganges
- Scotland & Wales (VHS NSI YF4) - hosted by Bernie Kopell: Scotrail, the Strathspey steam railway, Loch Ness, Isle of Skye, Snowdon Mountain Railway and the Ffestiniog Railway

China and India produced by France 2, written and directed by Francoise Gall and Bernard d'Abrigeon. Scotland & Wales produced by Network Programs International (Railway Adventures Across Europe). Sleeve & design (c)1995 National Syndications, Inc.

Condition: all factory sealed, never opened. China has a handwritten price sticker on the front of the shrink wrap. All have small tears in the wrap at the edges (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
